narr: A stationary front was located just north of the Mid-South during the afternoon of July 17, 2025. A very hot air mass was present south of the boundary with enough moisture to support isolated thunderstorms. A slow-moving storm tracked from northeast to southwest across Shelby County, resulting in flash flooding and some damaging winds.
ev: Mt Moriah Road and Clarke Rd were shut down due to flash flooding and water overtopping roads, leaving them impassable.
Roads were flooded with over 6 inches of water in parts of southeast Memphis.
